title: Italian Flatbread Pizza
description: A simple and delicious Italian-inspired flatbread pizza recipe. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or snack.
instructions: Roll out the Portuguese dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Spread the tomato sauce over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top the sauce with the mozzarella cheese, chopped basil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Cut into slices and serve immediately.
Optional: Top with lightly fermented flatbread for added crunch.
